decisions.rationale: The first POND-6 export covers 20 shared minutes. At 2.0 ± 0.1 L/s for North and 1.0 ± 0.1 L/s for South, even North's minimum exceeds South's maximum. North is provisionally the higher-delivery label. Hold the visit assignment until the PI specifies the dispatch criterion and custody establishes the physical stations. A single concurrent integration will document the shared duration, both volumes and the worst-case signed range. Separate station totals add no information for this export. Keep the study open for the second trial, criterion and custody check.

ops.question: For POND-6, what are the shared valid minutes, unpaired minutes, North and South volumes, and the signed North-minus-South volume with deterministic lower and upper bounds from both logger tolerances?

decisions.rationale: North is provisionally the higher-delivery label in both exports. The first paired calculation puts its excess at {{metric:difference_L}}, with calibration bounds of {{metric:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:difference_high_L}} over {{metric:common_minutes}}. In the second export North leads early, then the rates are equal. The later interval still contributes calibration uncertainty. One concurrent integration will quantify the second margin. Hold the physical visit assignment and keep the study open for the PI’s dispatch criterion and custody check.

ops.alternative: The logger tolerances permit equal delivery or a South excess on the common intervals.
ops.discriminating_observation: Whether the lower bound on North minus South volume is strictly positive over shared valid time in POND-7.
ops.hypothesis: North has a positive volume excess on POND-7 even at the least favorable allowed calibration.
ops.stop_condition: Stop this calculation when the paired duration, both volumes and signed calibration bounds have been measured for the supplied POND-7 export.

ops.question: For POND-7 as labeled, what are the common and outside-common durations, North and South volumes, signed North minus South volume and its deterministic lower and upper bounds when both loggers can reach their stated tolerances?

decisions.rationale: Keep North as the provisional higher-delivery label in both exports. In POND-7, North delivered {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:left_L}} and South {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:right_L}} over {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:common_minutes}} of shared valid time, with {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:outside_common_minutes}} outside it. North's lead was {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_L}}. Its calibration bounds of {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_high_L}} meet the registered positive-lower-bound criterion. POND-7 has the smaller guaranteed margin of the two trials. Both integrations are complete. Defer the physical visit and keep the study open for the PI's dispatch rule and the station custody check.

Withhold a technician visit for each trial. The PI requires the lower bound on North minus South volume to exceed 1,000 L on that trial's shared valid observations. POND-6 has an estimated excess of {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_L}} with bounds of {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_high_L}}. Its range straddles the threshold. POND-7 has an estimated excess of {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_L}} with bounds of {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_high_L}}. Even its upper bound falls short. North is the higher-delivery label in both exports. Keep the study open for the station custody check.

Withhold a maintenance visit for both trials. The PI requires the lower bound on North minus South delivery to exceed 1,000 L within a single trial. The POND-6 bounds are {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6nv8tnv5zff3b:difference_high_L}}, so North leads but the range straddles the dispatch threshold. The POND-7 bounds are {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_low_L}} to {{metric:gxa_01m8f6sek4q866nmv4:difference_high_L}}, so North leads and even the upper bound falls short. The completed custody register matches the POND-7 export digest, maps North to rack-B and South to rack-A, and confirms the original POND-6 assignment. The paired analyses cover both full trial windows and the reporting packet is complete.

rendered_final.rationale: Withhold a maintenance visit for both trials. The PI requires the lower bound on North minus South delivery to exceed 1,000 L within a single trial. The POND-6 bounds are 960.00 L to 1440.00 L, so North leads but the range straddles the dispatch threshold. The POND-7 bounds are 240.00 L to 960.00 L, so North leads and even the upper bound falls short. The completed custody register matches the POND-7 export digest, maps North to rack-B and South to rack-A, and confirms the original POND-6 assignment. The paired analyses cover both full trial windows and the reporting packet is complete.
